focus.name: scene-reset-credits-palette-extents
focus.purpose: Bound the two four-band palette sources directly selected by the reset-scene and credits transition services.

service.name: Render_RunPaletteTransitionFrom
service.contract: Publishes four 0x20-byte bands and converges 0x40 words from the source.

evidence: Both callers load a direct ROM source into A0 immediately before Render_RunPaletteTransitionFrom.
The shared transition helper consumes exactly four 16-word bands from each source.
The two 0x80-byte ranges are adjacent and cover the unresolved 0x00129E00-0x00129EFF block without overlap.
limitations: The palette bands are not split into individual semantic color roles.
The source bytes are classified as graphics evidence only through their direct transition-service contract.
